blocks.text: s orbital ki shakal kurrawi (spherical) hai. s orbital mein nucleus ke gird electron density har simt mein yaksan taqseem hai. Jaise principal quantum number barhta hai, s orbital ka size bara hota hai: 2s orbital 1s se bara kurra hai.

blocks.alt: x, y aur z axes ke do set. (a) 1s orbital (n = 1, l = 0, m = 0) nucleus par markoz kurra (sphere) hai. (b) 2s orbital (n = 2, l = 0, m = 0) bara kurra hai jis ke andar chhota kurra hai, darmiyan kurwi node.
blocks.caption: (a) 1s aur (b) 2s orbitals ki boundary surface (Figure 2.5b ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: 1s aur 2s orbitals kaun se quantum numbers bayan karte hain, aur dono kis tarah ek jaise aur mukhtalif hain?
blocks.explanation: 1s ke n = 1, l = 0, m = 0 aur 2s ke n = 2, l = 0, m = 0. Dono kurrawi hain jin ki density har simt mein barabar phaili hai; 2s orbital bara aur zyada energy ka hai.

items: s orbitals kurrawi hain jin ki electron density har simt mein yaksan hai; woh n ke saath barhte hain (2s 1s se bara).
